draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.57, the 251st-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 28th of 28 at WR. He went 202nd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (251st): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (15th percentile), 10-yard split (7th percentile). College production: 400 receiving yards in 2021, 26th of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 15 career games and 2 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 0 AV in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (5th percentile), team target share 2.7% (21st percentile). Played 5 of 17 games in 2024.
